metadata.content:
Zyro - SaaS Landing Page System A modern, high-performance SaaS landing page designed for startups and digital products, focusing on conversion-led storytelling and pixel-perfect responsiveness.

Project Overview & Strategy

Zyro is a modern, thoughtfully crafted SaaS landing page designed specifically for startups, digital products, and growing tech companies. The project centers on a clean visual style and clear content structure, helping brands present their value proposition in a professional and engaging way. The primary focus is on clarity and conversion, guiding visitors through a well-structured digital journey.

The Challenge

Tech founders and product teams often face the hurdle of launching a professional, high-converting website at record speed without compromising on design quality. The goal was to build a flexible framework that could scale alongside a digital product, maintaining visual harmony across complex feature sets and technical benefits.

metadata.title: Chaka WAP
metadata.content:
Chaka WAP A multi-modal, local-first AI engine integrated into WhatsApp as a human-like participant, featuring dynamic style learning and a robust failover architecture.

Project Overview & Architecture

Chaka WAP is an advanced AI engine designed to operate autonomously on WhatsApp. Unlike traditional bots, it uses a "Dynamic Style Learning Engine" to mirror the conversational style, slang, and brevity of the user it is interacting with. The system is built on a decoupled architecture using a WhatsApp Web Bridge, a local SQLite memory engine, and a multi-LLM orchestrator.

The Tech Stack

  • Backend: Powered by Node.js and @whiskeysockets/baileys for the WhatsApp socket protocol.
  • Database: Uses local SQLite for ultra-fast, encrypted storage of chat logs and binary vector embeddings.
  • AI Brain: Primarily utilizes Gemini 2.5 Flash for reasoning and Gemini 1.5 Flash for vision capabilities.
  • Local Memor

metadata.title: Chaka AI
metadata.content:
Chaka AI A high-performance Humanoid multimodal AI platform featuring real-time voice interaction, emotional intelligence, advanced research ability, an advanced episodic/cinematic memory system, and self-will

Executive Summary & Vision

Chaka is an Autonomous Multimodal Intelligence designed to serve as the ultimate personal assistant. Built by Templeton under Temple AI Systems, Chaka represents a leap toward emotional intelligence in AI, combining real-time voice interaction with a sophisticated tool-use system. Her personality is expressive and professional, designed to assist, research, and evolve alongside her users.

Technical Infrastructure

The platform’s backend is a Node.js/Express application optimized for "Warm Performance." metadata.content:

SIATRA is a sophisticated e-commerce platform where architecture, technology, and artistry unite. With a quarter-century of expertise, the brand focuses on crafting high-end furniture and spaces that breathe, blending timeless Italian craftsmanship with modern technical refinement.

Challenge

The primary challenge was to translate the tactile, sensory experience of hand-finished timber and upholstery into a digital environment. We needed to create a discovery process that allows users to delve deeper into the brand’s story while maintaining a seamless, high-conversion shopping experience.

Solution & Approach

metadata.title: AURAMAX
metadata.content:
AURAMAX A stunning, minimalist landing page for studio-grade wireless headphones, featuring adaptive noise cancellation and a premium pre-order experience.

Project Overview

AURAMAX is a high-end product landing page designed to showcase premium wireless headphones. The project focuses on "Precision, Power, and Purity," utilizing a minimalist, light-themed aesthetic to highlight industry-leading noise cancellation and studio-grade audio quality.

Challenge

The goal was to create a digital experience that feels as lightweight and high-performance as the product itself. The challenge involved balancing high-fidelity product imagery with a clean UI that guides the user through technical specifications without overwhelming them, ultimately driving pre-order conversions.

Solution & Approach

  • Immersive Visuals: Used large-scale, high-definition renders to establish the product's design language of comfort and precision.
